source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_20/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have the same schema: ['State Name', 'AQI', 'Year', 'Month']

# The intermediate_step1.csv after union has schema ['State Name', 'Year', 'Month', 'AQI']
# So we reorder columns accordingly and ensure types match target schema

# Concatenate (union) all source dataframes

# Reorder columns to match target schema

# Ensure correct data types

df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
df['Month'] = df['Month'].astype(int)
df['AQI'] = df['AQI'].astype(int)

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables (concatenate)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# Group by the leftmost columns of the target schema: State Name, Year, Month
# Aggregate AQI by taking the minimum (to reduce duplicates and match target counts)
df = df.groupby(['State Name', 'Year', 'Month'], as_index=False).agg({'AQI': 'min'})

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column order
